# Legacy commerce system baseline

## Context

The repository contains a frontend package, a Maven catalog service, a Python worker, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, Terraform, and a Kubernetes deployment.

## Baseline

The catalog service and worker depend on PostgreSQL. Docker Compose describes the local runtime topology, while Terraform and Kubernetes describe deployment concerns.

## Consequences

Future decisions can reference this observed Day 0 structure without treating inferred details as verified facts.

- package.json
- docker-compose.yml
- infra/main.tf
